title: IVG Savr 3000 Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Lemonade IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a punchy Blue Raspberry blend with a fizzy Lemonade twist. Sweet, tart and citrusy, it offers a flavourful and well-rounded vape experience. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 4ml refill container, designed to work seamlessly with the IVG Savr 3000 Pod Kit. The refill system tops up automatically, offering up to 3000 puffs depending on usage. How to Set Up: Remove the stopper from the 2ml pod. Remove the sticker and stopper from the 4ml refill container. Align pod and refill and press until they click securely into place. Slide the connected unit into the IVG Savr 3000 device. Allow a few moments for saturation before vaping. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
